data.title: Fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) – red light violation
data.summary: The Landkreis Musteruckermark Bußgeldstelle issued a fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) against Ronny Musterspree for running a red light in Musterprenzlau on 17 October 2026, fixing a total amount of €232.00 (fine, fee and delivery costs) and 1 point in the Fahreignungsregister.
data.explanation: This Bußgeldbescheid (fine notice) accuses you of running a red light and sets a total of €232.00 to pay, plus 1 point on your driving record (Fahreignungsregister). You may file a written objection (Einspruch) if you disagree, or submit it in person to be recorded; the app shows until when it must arrive at the Bußgeldstelle. If you do nothing, the notice becomes final and the full amount is due two weeks after that. Because a point and a sizeable fine are involved, consider getting advice from a traffic-law lawyer before deciding whether to object. Keep this letter and its delivery proof, since they fix when your objection period began.
data.tax_note: A traffic fine is a personal expense and is not deductible, so this document has no relevance for your tax return.
